verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Pipedream hosts MCP servers for its built-in catalog of 3,000+ pre-integrated APIs/apps (Slack, ClickUp, etc.) and lets developers connect to those without protocol plumbing, but nothing in the pack shows a workflow for importing a developer's own OpenAPI spec or custom code and turning it into a hosted MCP server — the ClickUp 'proxy forwards request' example is about pre-existing app credentials, not custom API onboarding.
